_about: Which store book page a carousel topic's link should open (lumebook.com/IL/he/books/<book>). 'pack' = the Carousel Machine pack for that topic named this catalogue book for the DM link; 'inferred' = matched by Claude from the catalogue descriptions in the packs, check on the site before relying on it. Add a topic when a new one is posted; the link maker falls back to the store home page and says so when a topic is missing. Titles were read from the live book pages on 24 Oct 2026 (every listed page loaded with the UTM tags).
